Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

Fast Out of State Shipping Available!..What the reviews say..The 2023 A6 is the quintessential Audi luxury sedan, featuring a cabin stuffed with technology that's expertly put together using premium materials. The A6's interior design is sleek, modern, and nicely put together from excellent-quality materials. Soft leather adorns the seats and armrests, rich-looking wood and nickel-finished metal trim is tastefully applied to the dash and doors, and the majority of the A6's secondary controls, climate, drive mode, etc.are handled by a large touch-sensitive panel underneath the main infotainment display. A similar system is used in the A8 luxury sedan and the Q8 crossover, and despite our usual griping about the takeover of touchscreen controls, it works well and provides satisfying haptic feedback. A large trunk and easy-to-fold rear seatbacks make the A6 great for hauling cargo. We fit six of our carry-on suitcases in the trunk, which ties both the E450 and the 540i. The Audi offered far more space than either of those two with the rear seats folded, managing to hold 20 cases, the Benz held 18 and the BMW 16. The Audi A6 is a well-rounded midsize luxury sedan that excels in a wide range of categories. It is comfortable and refined but still agile enough to engage the driver. And the A6 comes with a technology-rich and well-appointed interior, befitting its premium status. Is the A6 a good value? One of the Audi's most attractive character traits is its build quality. Interior surfaces are excellent to the eye and to the touch, and exterior panel gaps are consistent. Even up against rivals from BMW and Mercedes, the Audi feels top-notch. The A6 feels sophisticated and elegant during daily driving. But if you get the itch to tackle some high-speed corners, it's sporty and engaging. It's not loud or boisterous in any way, and from the driver's seat, it's an excellent experience. The A6 is sleek and understated, giving it a feeling of sophistication. From the outside, it looks luxurious without being gaudy, but on the inside it feels truly refined. Its sharp driving characteristics give it a bit of an edge as well.

Discover the efficiency and style of this 2025 Honda Civic Hybrid Sport, a vehicle engineered to deliver exceptional fuel economy without compromising on performance or features.

- 50 city / 47 highway MPG fuel economy

This Civic Hybrid Sport combines practicality with refined comfort. The 2.0L 16V DOHC engine paired with an eCVT transmission delivers impressive fuel efficiency, making every trip to the pump less frequent. Whether navigating city streets or cruising the highway, this sedan maintains responsive handling and smooth acceleration while keeping operating costs down.

The interior reflects Honda's commitment to driver satisfaction. Heated front bucket seats provide comfort during colder months, while the power moonroof brings natural light and airiness to the cabin. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of sophistication, and the telescoping tilt steering wheel allows you to find your ideal driving position. Dual zone automatic climate control ensures both driver and passenger maintain their preferred temperature.

Technology enhances every drive. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility keeps your smartphone seamlessly integrated, giving you access to navigation, music, and communication at your fingertips. The Adaptive Cruise Control system intelligently adjusts your speed in traffic, reducing driver fatigue during longer drives. The Blind Spot Information System provides added awareness, and the rear parking camera assists with precision parking.

Safety is paramount in this design. Standard safety features include dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together to maintain grip and stability in varied driving conditions. The brake assist system and four-wheel independent suspension contribute to confident handling and control.

This gray 2025 Honda Civic Hybrid Sport represents an intelligent choice for drivers seeking reliability, efficiency, and modern convenience. We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this vehicle firsthand.

          • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted.           • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
          • Active blind spot system - Protect your blind side. You checked the mirror, looked over your shoulder and still nearly collided with the car next to you. An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians.             Convenience
            • GPS linked cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until GPS linked cruise control set the pace. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
            Safety and Security
            • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
            • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
            • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. This 2024 Honda Accord Hybrid Sport-L combines practical efficiency with refined comfort, delivering a vehicle designed for drivers who value both performance and fuel economy.

- Hybrid powertrain with 46 city/41 highway MPG efficiency
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow
- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS) active safety technology
- Blind Spot Information (BSI) System warning
- Power moonroof
- Leather-trimmed heated front bucket seats
- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto integration
- 180-Watt audio system with 8 speakers
- Automatic temperature control with dual-zone front A/C
- Power driver seat with memory function
- Exterior parking camera
- 19" matte black alloy wheels
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Adaptive front headlights with delay-off function

The Accord Hybrid operates on a 2.0L 16V DOHC engine paired with an eCVT transmission, providing responsive acceleration while maintaining excellent fuel efficiency. With front-wheel drive and four-wheel independent suspension, this sedan handles responsively whether navigating city streets or highway driving. Every component works together to create a seamless driving experience that doesn't sacrifice performance for economy.

Safety stands as a cornerstone of this vehicle's design. The comprehensive suite includes multiple airbags—dual front, dual front side, knee, and overhead—along with ABS brakes, 4-wheel disc brakes, Electronic Stability Control, and traction control. The Lane Keeping Assist System helps maintain your position in traffic, while the Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots. The rear camera provides visibility when reversing, and HondaLink emergency communication connects you to assistance when needed.

Inside, the Sport-L trim emphasizes comfort and convenience. Heated leather-trimmed front bucket seats adjust via power controls with driver memory settings. The dual-zone automatic climate control maintains your preferred temperature, while the power moonroof brings in natural light. Bluetooth connectivity enables hands-free calling, and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto integration seamlessly connects your smartphone for navigation and entertainment.

This Accord Hybrid has undergone a thorough 182-point safety inspection, with service documentation included. The vehicle carries a balance of manufacturer warranty coverage and comes with two sets of keys. Fresh oil has just been changed, ensuring the engine starts this next chapter of ownership ready to perform.

At 8,725 miles, this Accord represents minimal use and remains well within the scope of a newer vehicle. The gray exterior finish maintains a professional appearance while complementing the refined interior appointments.

We invite you to visit our showroom to view this 2024 Honda Accord Hybrid Sport-L in person and experience its balance of efficiency, safety, and comfort firsthand.

  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.
